title: 证明自动形式化在Lean 4中的鲁棒性评估
summary: 首次研究证明自动形式化模型的鲁棒性。提出全局扰动（改写风格）和局部扰动（改变值、符号或证明步骤）两类扰动，构建基于miniF2F和MATH-500的基准，评估七个最新模型。结果表明所有模型对全局扰动敏感，且大多无法忠实反映局部扰动。
summary_en: First study on robustness of proof autoformalization models. Proposes global (paraphrasing style) and local (altering values/symbols/steps) perturbations, builds benchmark on miniF2F and MATH-500, evaluates seven recent models. All models are sensitive to global perturbations and mostly fail to faithfully reflect local perturbations.
